simple.meaning: עֳנִי (ʻŏnîy) is a Hebrew object word meaning “depression , i.e. misery.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

occurrences.englishText: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “Behold, you are with child, and will bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, because Yahweh has heard your affliction.
Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she named him Reuben. For she said, “Because Yahweh has looked at my affliction; for now my husband will love me.”

Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked you last night.”
The name of the second, he called Ephraim:† “Ephraim” sounds like the Hebrew for “twice fruitful”. “For God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.”
Yahweh said, “I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of their taskmasters, for I know their sorrows.

I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt to the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, to a land flowing with milk and honey.” ’
The people believed, and when they heard that Yahweh had visited the children of Israel, and that he had seen their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshiped.

You shall eat no leavened bread with it. You shall eat unleavened bread with it seven days, even the bread of affliction (for you came out of the land of Egypt in haste) that you may remember the day when you came out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.
Then we cried to Yahweh, the God of our fathers. Yahweh heard our voice, and saw our affliction, our toil, and our oppression.

She vowed a vow, and said, “Yahweh of Armies, if you will indeed look at the affliction of your servant and remember me, and not forget your servant, but will give to your servant a boy, then I will give him to Yahweh all the days of his life, and no razor shall come on his head.”
For Yahweh saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very bitter; for all, slave and free, and there was no helper for Israel.

Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for Yahweh’s house one hundred thousand talents* A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds or 965 Troy ounces, so 100,000 talents is about 3 metric tons of gold, one million talents† about 30,000 metric tons of silver, and bronze and iron without weight; for it is in abundance. I have also prepared timber and stone; and you may add to them.
“You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry by the Red Sea,
If I am wicked, woe to me.
“Now my soul is poured out within me.
My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest.
If they are bound in fetters,
He delivers the afflicted by their affliction,
Take heed, don’t regard iniquity;
that I may show all of your praise.
Consider my affliction and my travail.
You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy.
For our soul is bowed down to the dust.
Do you show wonders to the dead?
Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death,
Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction,
This is my comfort in my affliction,
Unless your law had been my delight,
Consider my affliction, and deliver me,
lest they drink, and forget the law,
Behold, I have refined you,
Judah has gone into captivity because of affliction,
Jerusalem remembers in the days of her affliction and of her miseries
Her filthiness was in her skirts.
I am the man who has seen affliction
Remember my affliction and my misery,
